skills.skill_desc:
Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order.
When Lunox uses <font color="a6aafb">Power of Order</font>, she gains 10% Spell Vamp. When she uses <font color="a6aafb">Power of Chaos</font>, she gains 10% <font color="7f62fe">Magic Penetration</font>.

Lunox summons a rain of starlight upon nearby enemies, dealing 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+110% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>. The starlight then returns to Lunox, each recovering 75<font color="62f8fe"> (+30% Total Magic Power)</font> HP to her (doubled when hitting enemy heroes).

This skill shares a cooldown with <font color="a6aafb">Chaos Assault</font>. It grants <font color="a6aafb">Power of Order</font> and ends the <font color="a6aafb">Power of Chaos</font> state.

Lunox unleashes <font color="a6aafb">Chaos Energy</font> at a target enemy, dealing 250<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> (+ 3.5% target's <font color="26e407"><1005></font>) <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> (+ 2.1% against creeps).

This skill shares its cooldown with <font color="a6aafb">Starlight Pulse</font>. Using it grants <font color="a6aafb">Power of Chaos</font> and ends the <font color="a6aafb">Power of Order</font> state.

Lunox channels the power of Order and Chaos in the target direction, dealing 300<font color="62f8fe"> (+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in its path and slowing them by 40% for 2s.

Lunox is twisted by the powers of Chaos and Order.

When <font color="a6aafb">Power of Order</font> is dominant, she can cast <font color="a6aafb">Brilliance</font> to become invincible and deal continuous damage to nearby enemies.
When <font color="a6aafb">Power of Chaos</font> is dominant, she can cast <font color="a6aafb">Darkening</font> to blink in a target direction and greatly reduce the cooldown of <font color="a6aafb">Chaos Assault</font> for a brief period.
